worker/job-local trial process integrals cannot mutate accepted-window totals until admission against a matching accepted certificate
discarded/rejected trial contributions contribute zero to accepted-window aggregates

a complete window freezes the existing F-WOF33 wofost_accepted_window_aggregates_t semantic carrier

the seam has no calendar-midnight, file-I/O, MODFLOW, HeadCalc, Jacobian or Newton dependency
